name: Shell Mono
description: JetBrains Mono for every role, upright and italic.

provenance.attribution: JetBrains Mono, by its project authors, self-hosted from its pinned npm package for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.copyright: Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)
provenance.maintainer: The upstream project, at the version fonts.provenance.json pins
provenance.derivation: Role metrics by the platform for the shell direction (packs-plan §3.2); font files copied unmodified from @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono 5.3.0, never subset or renamed inside.

fallbacks: JetBrains Mono is followed by metric-matched fallback faces over local system monospace fonts (size-adjust and ascent, descent, and line-gap overrides), then a system stack and a generic family.
There's a fallback face at each weight the roles set, over the system bold for a heading, and the italic falls back to the system italic.
Glyphs outside every shipped face's unicode-range render in the declared system stack, so text never goes missing.
caveats: Monospace prose reads slower than a proportional face over long passages, so the body measure is 72 characters, for a transcript column's prose.

The latin-ext subsets, upright and italic (15,196 B and 16,520 B), load only on a page whose text needs them, such as ő or ł; a Latin page loads 83,368 B. Other scripts render in the declared system stack.
